tagline: International Association representing European inland shipping, insurance and ship survey sectors
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is a professional association with no commercial activity. No financial KPIs available. Participation in the annual congress by 225 delegates from 11 European countries illustrates the international engagement of the sector and the association's relevance for representing inland shipping interests.

kpis.name: Annual congress participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries representing shipping, insurance and ship survey sectors.
kpis.description: 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt am Main attracted 225 participants from 11 European countries
kpis.signal: Strong international participation demonstrates sectoral engagement and association relevance

kpis.name: Countries represented at congress
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented among congress participants, reflecting the pan-European scope of IVR membership.
kpis.description: 2024 congress participants represented 11 different European countries
kpis.signal: Pan-European scope demonstrates broad sectoral representation and international coordination across inland waterway sectors

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp, representing insurance, brokerage, ship operators and maritime experts.
kpis.description: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (4 November 2024) attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany
kpis.signal: Inaugural event demonstrates strong sector engagement in risk management and technical knowledge sharing within European inland navigation
